description: Creates a schedule that issues an invoice every N days/weeks/months (gym pass, tutoring, rent, SaaS plan). Each run is an invoice the customer confirms — in the Kaspi.kz app (kind="phone") or through a pay link; Kaspi has no card-on-file auto-debit. The customer's own page (customerUrl) shows the schedule. startAt sets the first run (default now). Needs subscriptions:manage or invoices:write.

amount.description: Amount in KZT per run; whole tenge for kind="phone"

email.description: Gets the pay link by email on each live run

description.description: Shown to the customer, e.g. "Gym pass — October"

kind.description: "qr" (default: pay link, emailed if customer.email) or "phone" (invoice pushed into the customer's Kaspi.kz app)

maxRuns.description: Stop after N invoices; omit for no end

metadata.description: Copied into every invoice and webhook

reminders.description: Customer reminders: N days before each invoice, and after an unpaid one

startAt.description: ISO date/time of the first invoice; default now

name: qutpay_create_subscription
title: Create a subscription (recurring invoices)
